original.speaker: Robert McMahon — Senior Vice President and CFO, Agilent Technologies
original.evidence_excerpt: With the change in revenue, we now expect full-year fiscal 2023 non-GAAP earnings per share to be between $5.60 and $5.65, representing growth of 7%-8%.

original.speaker: Adam Norwitt — CEO, Amphenol
original.evidence_excerpt: For the second quarter, we expect sales in the range of $1.315 billion-$1.355 billion and EPS in the range of $0.56-$0.58 respectively.

original.speaker: Richard A. Gonzalez — Chairman and CEO, AbbVie
original.evidence_excerpt: As a result, we are raising our full-year EPS guidance range by $0.33 to $7.66-$7.76.

original.speaker: Scott Reents — EVP and CFO, AbbVie
original.evidence_excerpt: Turning to our financial outlook, we are raising our full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance by $0.10 to between $10.71 and $10.91.

original.speaker: KC McClure — CFO, Accenture
original.evidence_excerpt: For the Q4 of FY21, we expect revenues to be in the range of $13.1 billion-$13.5 billion.

original.speaker: Don McGuire — CFO, ADP
original.evidence_excerpt: We continue to anticipate soft pays per control growth through the end of the year and expect worksite employee growth to hold steady at about 3%, keeping us on track for our full-year outlook for worksite employee growth of 2%-3% and revenue growth of 3%-4%.
